creator: Shen Zhou
title: Anchorage on a rainy night
credit: Gift of Marie-Hélène and Guy Weill, 2015
rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access image
alt: A tall ink landscape with mountains, trees and water; inscriptions occupy the upper area, with red seals among the writing and landscape.
museum_account: The Met relates the painting to a boat stay with a friend after rain. Its record provides the poem and inscription in translation, and describes a responding poem by Wu Kuan.
presentation: Preserve the entire supplied vertical photograph, including the pictured inscriptions and margins. This does not establish coverage of every mounting element or every separately photographed part of the physical scroll.
